description: Level crossings is a dataset listed in SBB open data platform, an open data platform of a railway operator, published or maintained by SBB (Swiss Federal Railways). Bahnübergänge sind niveau-gleiche Gleisquerungen, die Signaltechnisch gesichert; mit Blinklicht/Schranken oder mit Verkehrsregelungsanlage oder ungesichert sind. Die Daten geben ausschliesslich das SBB AG-Streckennetz wieder. Die Daten unterliegen einer wöchentlichen Aktualisierung und Vervollständigung. Level crossings are track crossings of the same level, which are secured with flashing/barriers or with traffic control systems or unsecured. Coverage: Switzerland. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal files it under Mobility and Transport. Its keywords are Infrastruktur, Blaulicht. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is https://data.sbb.ch/page/licence. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-sbb-open-data-portal.
